# Awesome AI Research Tools (2026)

> The comprehensive curated catalog of state-of-the-art AI tools, literature discovery engines, LaTeX workflows, and computational reproducibility frameworks.

## Canonical Resources
- Repository: https://github.com/mahmoudsajjadi/awesome-ai-research-tools
- Web Directory: https://mahmoudsajjadi.github.io/awesome-ai-research-tools/
- Sister Coding Catalog: https://github.com/mahmoudsajjadi/awesome-ai-coding-tools

## Core Categories & SOTA Tools
- **Literature Discovery**: Consensus, Elicit, Semantic Scholar, Scite.ai, Undermind.
- **Citation Graphs & Co-Citation**: Connected Papers, Litmaps, ResearchRabbit.
- **Paper Reading & Synthesis**: SciSpace, NotebookLM, PaperQA2, ChatPDF.
- **LaTeX & Writing**: LaTeX-OCR, Paperpal, Writefull, Overleaf AI.
- **Experiment Tracking & MLOps**: Weights & Biases, MLflow, Zenodo, Comet ML.
- **Autonomous Research Agents**: Stanford STORM, The AI Scientist (Sakana AI), Auto-Researcher.
